description: Learn to listen, critical think and expand through nuance #selflove #criticalthinking #selfpeace
transcript: I am a communications executive, and I've learned three things about people, people do not listen, people do not prioritize nuance, and people do not critically think. Those three things are what keeps my nervous system aligned. I understand that just because I'm receiving information, it is not required to go to my mental file cabinet. Some of those things have to be recycled, some of that information has to be passed along. Just because you receive information does not mean you need to respond to it. And I see that a lot with everything. Everyone always needs to explain themselves. You don't have to explain yourself. Take the information and go.
